headlines.headline: ST. JOHN'S LOSES GUARD DONNIE FREEMAN FOR THE SEASON TO ACHILLES INJURY BEFORE TIP-OFF
headlines.detail: Rising junior guard Donnie Freeman underwent surgery for a non-contact Achilles injury suffered in a team workout, ruling him out for all of 2026-27 before the season even begins. Coach Rick Pitino called it a major blow to the Red Storm's depth heading into Big East play.

headlines.headline: LAKERS' REPORTED $12 BILLION SALE HEADLINES PRESEASON AS LEBRON DEBUTS WITH SIXERS
headlines.detail: A reported $12 billion sale of the Lakers — a North American sports-franchise record — is the backdrop to a 67-game preseason slate now underway league-wide. LeBron James opened his 24th season with his fourth franchise after signing with Philadelphia.

headlines.headline: FALCONS' JAMES PEARCE JR. SUSPENDED 8 GAMES FOR CONDUCT POLICY VIOLATION
headlines.detail: Atlanta edge rusher James Pearce Jr. was suspended eight games without pay for violating the NFL's personal-conduct policy. The league is also reviewing possible discipline for 49ers owner Jed York following his arrest in Ohio.

headlines.headline: OHIO STATE'S JEREMIAH SMITH SETS PROGRAM RECORDS AS THE SENATE PASSES THE PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT
headlines.detail: Jeremiah Smith broke Ohio State's career receptions and touchdown records, while the Senate passed the Protect College Sports Act 77-22, setting a uniform national NIL standard. The slate is quiet until Friday, when No. 20 Iowa visits No. 18 Washington.
